title: Encoding an input-index circuit
statement: For natural numbers $n,j$ with $j<n$, the Boolean-word encoding of the circuit on $n$ inputs with no gates and output vertex $j$ is the word consisting of $n$ true bits followed by false, then two false bits, then $j$ true bits followed by false.
